description: AI-powered private money platform for real estate investment loans. Assess a deal, run LTV, LTC, DSCR, NOI and debt yield, learn private-credit terms, and ask the Bancaverse team to reach out. Fix & flip, DSCR rentals, bridge, construction, multifamily and commercial.

interface.longDescription: AI-powered private money platform for real estate investment loans. Describe your deal and get a preliminary snapshot: LTV, LTC, ARV-LTV, DSCR, NOI, debt yield and payments, plus what a private lender will ask for. Learn any private-credit term in plain English. Covers fix & flip, DSCR rentals, bridge, construction, multifamily and commercial (business-purpose only). When you're ready, add your deal with the Bancaverse AI application or ask the team to reach out. Educational and preliminary only, not an approval.
defaultPrompt: Run my numbers: LTV, LTC, DSCR
